method: See data/annotations/operational-v6-review-protocol.json. Superpixel ids refer to scripts/label_superpixels.py PARAMS on the pinned native image; polygons are native 1024 px coordinates and override superpixels.

scenes.note: Central raised layered slab and right fractured-plate pavement left unknown (ambiguous). Small (<~10 cm) gravel not labelled as obstacle.
Flat bedrock plain = ground; rover shadow = ground; distant plains/hills beyond the near ridge = distant unknown. Individual raised rocks/slabs traced.

Arm structure across the top and both wheels = hardware. Distant buttes = distant unknown. Bright flat bedrock exposures and the central rover shadow = ground. Bright right-foreground slabs and side shadows left unknown.
Low-light scene. Arm column and turret, both wheels and frame edges = hardware. Very dark lower third left unknown; large tilted left-foreground slab left unknown.

Platy block field. Broad flat plates on the left/upper plain = ground; block-rich right half and the rover-shadowed foreground left unknown except individually traced raised blocks. Arm, turret, wheels and frame = hardware.
Backlit low-light bedrock: mostly ground (useful negatives). Arm/deck at top-left and wheels = hardware. Darkest lower part left unknown; sun glare corner not labelled.
Mountain slope and sky = distant unknown. Gravel plain and the central rover shadow = ground (small pebbles ignored). Rocky lower-left lit area left unknown.

(Was test_v6; consumed after one evaluation, moved to training in v7.) TEST (labelled before any prediction). Large fractured left-centre outcrop left unknown (ambiguous); detached/raised blocks traced. Sand plain = ground.

(Was test_v6; consumed after one evaluation, moved to training in v7.) TEST (labelled before any prediction). Jumbled raised-block terrain: clear raised blocks and the rover-scale outcrop block = obstacle; sand trough = ground; rover-shadowed jumble and turret shadow left unknown.

(Was test_v6; consumed after one evaluation, moved to training in v7.) TEST (labelled before any prediction). Discrete rocks on rippled sand: 21 rocks traced individually; sand = ground; distant slope = distant unknown; dark lower-right rover shadow/hardware left unknown.
Block field: upright and tabular raised blocks = obstacle (including their shadowed faces). Shadowed gaps between blocks = ground. Bright distant left outcrop and turret shadow left unknown.
Central raised layered slab = obstacle. Bright flat platy bedrock and sand = ground; rover shadow = ground. Raised slab edges near the right wheel and lower-left left unknown.
Same physical outcrop as Sol 2900 (both training). Central raised slab left unknown as in 2900; upper plain and shadowed foreground gravel = ground.
Raised bright blocks near the turret and in the lit lower-right = obstacle. Distant platy plain and shadowed foreground = ground. Overexposed band and the rest of the lit lower-right left unknown.
Bright flat-lying bedrock slabs on sand = ground (teaches flat slab is not an obstacle). Standing block 107 = obstacle. Distant butte = distant unknown.

TEST (labelled before any prediction, on a contrast-stretched copy). Dark scene: polygons only. Two large boulders and the raised outcrop face behind them = obstacle; arm/turret and wheels = hardware; sand/gravel foreground = ground; deep shadows left unknown.
TEST (labelled before any prediction). Plate field: bright flat plates and gravel = ground (false-positive test). Tilted raised slabs beside the left wheel left unknown. Arm and turret = hardware.
TEST (labelled before any prediction). Broad flat bright bedrock and the arm shadow across it = ground (false-positive test). One raised block (77) and a small rock (71) = obstacle.
